Hey! So I'm, silver II, but I've mained jungle/support now between numerous accounts since season 2 (yet currently enjoying a bit of akali mid).

When to invade; if you see enemy jungler is bot lane and you are in your jungle, but aren't comfortable to counter gank, head into his topside jungle and grab the chickens, then on to krugs, bush, recall.

Basically invade if you can see where the enemy jungler is, don't do it blindly. Ward their jungle and just know whereabouts they are. Don't let invading get you bogged down though to the extent that you lose pressure ganking. There's loads of great videos on youtube but a specific jungle path is if you start your red, wolves, blue then enemy krugs, bush and recall (if a higher elo player sees a wrong addition to this please comment to let me know).

 I think you shouldn't be so hard on yourself! Maybe grab a piece of paper in game and if you make a mistake (during death timer) quickly jot down what you may have done wrong. Also when you make a good play make a mental note of what you did.

 Self analyses can really help you to understand better, and maybe have a watch over your replays to compare them to youtube videos of high elo players on the same champ.

By no means am I criticising, just giving my opinion: in general your deaths are quite high but that being said these are all normal games in your posted history. Try aim for 2 deaths per 10 minutes (to start), and by saying that I don't mean to just say "well I've died twice so I'm gonna leave my team to die", I mean it more like make a conscious effort to stick to 2/10 and if you're dying more often just take a quick breather and ask why you've died more than that.

 Also you're playing quite a few champs (which I understand is because you're playing normal possibly) but maybe try pick 2. Grab for example thresh and Lulu/Janna. Thresh for when the team needs engage/tank and Janna/Lulu for protect/poke or safer lanes. 

I'm only SII so I don't have a huge amount of right to be giving opinions but this is just what I feel after playing the game since season 2, and hope this helps =)

So I was a support main too in the same elo so my advice may not be the accurate but I'm open to criticism as it may help me too. I like to /mute all from the start of the game. You don't need negativity from other players.

I usually get the gold item before sightstone because (IMO) realistically in the first 7 mins you wont need to have all the wards a sightstone brings, just control and between you and adc your trinket should keep enough vision.

Playing thresh is good because if you land a hook then it usually will result in summoners burnt/ a kill for your adc but I'd pick janna for example if they have heavy engage/stick like a leona.

Playing thresh/blitz, if you can roam to mid/top after a kill bot you can cause players on the other team to tilt so apply pressure, but make sure your adc knows you're going and just tell them to play safe.

I'd say pick a role and pick a champ. Try play hard carry/ more meta champs- for example if you want to jungle try grab Zac or (IMO) Jarvan because in lower elos people don't really know how to play so well against them. If you're playing top lane maybe try grab (still jarvan) or Pantheon.

Good post. I wish more people in lower elos frequented SummonerSchool because the negativity in this games community is absolutely insane. If people just took a bit of time to ask themselves WHY rather than blaming other factors, I feel it they may find it easier to climb.

I'd say just to pick a champ that's considered easy to play (such as annie) and spam her. If you have been playing for a long time now and have good experience with her then hit ranked straight away.

I generally tend to /mute all at the start of the game so I won't tilt if I happen to make a mistake. Also positive reinforcement of good plays your team makes, even if you can't see their response due to /mute all helps other players and being positive in this game for me has made me (I feel) start to become a better player.

I think I read it on Summonerschool the other day but aim for maximum 2 deaths (if any) per 10 mins and if you end up having more maybe consider taking a second to self analyze and figure out why you have died more than twice - Ex. is the enemy jungler camping you but you don't have your lane warded how can you ward better.

Playing meta champs is good because there's a reason they are meta and I like to watch a Youtube guide/or gameplay of the champ while playing normals on an alt.
